summary: Full stack test of Nexus Checkpoint A.5 (dark glass builder + AI Magic Loop). Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass in test_nexus_magic.py covering founder gate on all magic+admin endpoints (8 tid'd routes deny tftwo, allow stealth), estimate (0 credits + note), full improve_draft lifecycle → awaiting_approval with all 5 stages + honest score ≤95 + provider_usage 0 LLM, approve→draft-only isolation (published_version unchanged and unselected entities byte-identical), pause/resume/stop, clone_variant → completed with variant listed and load creating auto_backup, dry_run→completed and decide 400/404, founder_max clamps up + normal clamps down, animation_style portal_spin_fast produces spin ops, unsupported avatar_gait/pbr_daylight → 400, runtime_style neon_dusk produces update_zone ops, living_editor with mock:true produces add_entity + 0 LLM calls, save-version ≥1001 + rollback preserves published, audit contains magic_* actions. Frontend (desktop 1920x1080 as stealth): all required testids render — topbar (public/draft-chip/live-preview/mp/publish/save/rollback), left cards (zones/assets Meshy CONNECTED disabled, systems, versions, multiplayer real count), center (viewport 3D + magic + avatar), right (orai + runs + checklist all PASS + activity). Magic Loop select-all→14 selected, invert flips, estimate panel shows 'LLM calls 0 · Meshy 0 · Image 0 · Deterministic local proposer — zero paid calls'. Start button spawned a run; card in ACTIVE RUNS shows RUNNING then transitions to AWAITING APPROVAL with real stage progress bars; reject clears it. Reload persistence verified (14 run status chips reappeared after page.reload). Live preview toggle works. Member (tftwo) at /admin/nexus correctly denied with nexus-admin-denied 'Founder only.'. Mobile 390x844: nexus-mobile-tabs visible, each tab (build/magic/orai/runs/system) reveals its section, no horizontal overflow. Zero paid provider calls made (Meshy=0, LLM=0, image=0 across all runs).
critical_code_review_comments: nexus.py L297 `_aio.get_event_loop().create_task(nm.execute_run(rid))` — inside FastAPI async handler, prefer `asyncio.create_task(...)` directly (get_event_loop is deprecated when called from a running loop in Python 3.12+). Works today but emits DeprecationWarning in future runtimes.

nexus_magic.py L297 clone_variant: `run.get('label')` referenced but `run` at that point is the DB doc lacking 'label' preservation across _set calls — verified works (label persisted from insert), but consider explicit read-modify.
nexus_magic.py L235 `_set` updates heartbeat on every patch, including a patch that itself sets status=paused; the stall-detector at L309 nexus.py has cutoff 25s which is fine.
ActiveRuns.jsx polls every 2.5s across the founder session — fine at low volume but each poll is 2 API calls; consider batching to single /magic/state endpoint if run counts grow.
AdminNexus.jsx L110 denial check uses `user.admin_role !== 'founder' && user.username !== 'stealth'` — hardcodes username. Prefer purely `admin_role !== 'founder'` since role is the source of truth.

Pre-existing platform noise: /admin/nexus surfaces multiple 401/403 console errors from unauthenticated background probes to unrelated endpoints — not a Nexus regression but worth an eventual cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all Checkpoint A.5 selectors and flows exercised (desktop + mobile)

seed_data_creation: Tests left several TEST_-labeled magic runs and one TEST_manual_save version (v1001+) plus one TEST_clone variant in the draft world. All approve/reject decisions in the test suite reject rather than apply, so the draft is unchanged; the one approve step in TestImproveDraftLifecycle::test_full_run_and_approve_draft_only bumps draft_version but only edits the 2 selected entities and never touches published.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_magic.py alongside /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_phase1.py for Nexus regression. Magic tests are fully deterministic (no LLM/Meshy/image calls) and complete in ~35s. Living_editor MUST be started with settings.mock=true — the test enforces this. Frontend caveat: on /nexus with mobile viewport (390x844) Playwright without pointer:coarse won't render play shell — pre-existing headless limitation documented in iter141. All Checkpoint A.5 UI selectors verified to exist and be interactive: nexus-topbar, nexus-nav-public, nexus-draft-version, nexus-live-preview-toggle, nexus-nav-mp, nexus-publish-btn, nexus-save-version-btn, nexus-rollback-latest-btn, nexus-card-zones/assets/systems/versions/multiplayer/magic/orai/runs/avatar, nexus-viewport, nexus-checklist, nexus-activity, nexus-mobile-tabs, nexus-tab-{build|magic|orai|runs|system}, magic-select-all/clear/invert/selected-count, magic-mode-*, magic-style-select, magic-founder-max, magic-estimate-btn/panel, magic-start-btn/dryrun-btn, run-status-*, run-pause/resume/stop/approve/reject-*, runs-pause-all/stop-all, variant-load-*.
